text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need to lock cuts for the Apex initiative. proposal: move Tenant Insights (rich dashboards) to v1, ship a minimal telemetry surface in MVP. target ship window still May 17. can we agree?
Liam O'Connor: what's the customer impact? ACME pilot will expect insights. any way to give them a slice without full build?
Maya Patel: good call. my thought: MVP exposes a limited 'pilot insights' feed (opt-in) + export we can toggle. full dashboards deferred. reduces scope by ~3 dev-weeks.
Andrea Gomez: worried about perceived downgrade. ACME signed up for insights. if we flag as "pilot view" will that be acceptable to them?
Devon Chu: technically we can ship a gated path: feature flag apex.tenant_insights = "pilot" that streams top-k metrics. low effort: ~2w dev + 1w QA. we can also stub historical retention to cut infra work.
Maya Patel: OK — decision options: (A) MVP minimal pilot (flagged, no historical storage) — meets ship date. (B) keep full insights and slip 3 weeks. I prefer A.
Devon Chu: also propose util caching layer to avoid p99 regressions. adds config: "cache_mode=light".
Maya Patel: can someone own customer comms? we'll need to set expectations for ACME and other pilots.
Andrea Gomez: I can draft the note. will call it "pilot telemetry preview" and surface limitations.
Maya Patel: @Liam can you confirm SLA/enterprise gating? we should list rollout criteria before we cut.
Liam O'Connor: yes — add these as rollout criteria: 1) no P0 incidents for 72h on pilot traffic, 2) p95 latency <200ms for insights API, 3) cost delta <5% on hosting for tokenized telemetry.
Maya Patel: perfect. product-bot please open a decision ticket with option A and the rollout checklist. tagging @Andrea for comms and @Devon for impl estimates.
product-bot: created ticket INF-2247: "Apex: MVP pilot telemetry vs full insights" — https://redwood.internal/INF-2247 (assigned to Maya, Andrea, Devon).
Liam O'Connor: add one more line: if any dataplane error rate >1% during canary, rollback.
Andrea Gomez: I'll collect ACME feedback and send draft comms by EOD Thursday.
Maya Patel: thanks team — let's recon Friday EOD to finalize. :thumbsup:
